task_scope: Bounded public-source resolution for existing NDC/Darier comparator; no new-lead screen count

updates.name: NDC-9009 / Darier local proof
updates.decision: Retain conditional local qualification; require interpretable dantrolene and current-care benchmarks before advancement. No S tier.
updates.what_changed: Dantrolene has an adult clinical completer signal; NDC value must clear a real clinical comparator instead of relying on unknown trial outcomes.
updates.go: Identity/free exposure/topical delivery and delayed mature adhesion/permeability rescue, with healthy-tissue and systemic margin plus active comparator.
updates.stop: No functional exposure without injury, only markers or differentiation timing, or no meaningful advantage over an obtainable comparator.

updates.name: Dantrolene sodium / Darier
updates.decision: Adult clinical benchmark and mechanistic comparator; weak positive available-case signal, not durable barrier restoration or topical proof.
updates.supersedes: Actual SUM-151495 result tables unread; do not infer outcome from trial completion.

document_status.caution: Both public uploads retain draft/editorial text; use as sponsor-submitted evidence. The lay summary identifies a manuscript.

denominators.reported_reason: Insufficient response for all six in manuscript flow diagram, according to summary; surrounding prose says most commonly
denominators.do_not_infer: 10 completers does not mean 10 responders; enrolled n is 16, not planned n20.

efficacy_notes: Positive difference is a reduction/improvement. Reported paired estimates, not independent reanalysis.
MADRS-S and treatment satisfaction differences were nonsignificant.
Visit means have changing denominators; secondary analyses are exploratory without multiplicity adjustment.
The six discontinuers supplied no later outcomes, creating favorable selection.
Retinoid washout worsened baseline disease; six of ten restarted retinoids before nine-month followup.
Short half-life alone cannot exclude lasting biology, but these data cannot identify durability because of co-treatment and no control.

events.timing: Serious event predose during washout; infections continued on treatment
Not during washout; hospitalization; investigator unrelated

limitations: Baseline liver disease/abnormal chemistry and relevant comorbidities excluded.
Event counts divided by n16 are not verified unique-patient incidence.
Narrative possible pneumonia causality conflicts with the only pneumonia explicitly predose; retain timing.
No no-muscle-toxicity conclusion: expected mild events excluded and muscle enzymes not tested.

historical_record_discrepancy.interpretation: Use conducted-study result document; do not combine historical protocol fields into final analysis. Underlying SAP and manuscript not recovered.

additional_comparator_evidence.evidence: Patient-cell and other model mitochondrial calcium/respiration and cell adhesion response to dantrolene.
additional_comparator_evidence.limit: Abstract only; not adult trial or proof exact ATP2A2 knockout adhesion result rescued.

additional_comparator_evidence.evidence: Publisher listing reports inflammatory changes, clinical improvement, partial barrier-marker normalization.
additional_comparator_evidence.limit: No full text; drugs/n/comparator/direct barrier and tolerability unverified. Do not convert markers into function.

additional_comparator_evidence.evidence: Ustekinumab 45 mg weeks0/4 then12-weekly disease control with co-therapy; other courses heterogeneous.
additional_comparator_evidence.limit: Between-patient observational comparison, no direct barrier readout, one early infectious readmission. Not randomized active comparison.

additional_comparator_evidence.evidence: Mixed IL17/IL23/JAK/TYK2 series; IL17-high patient nonresponse; hospitalized herpes on upadacitinib and dizziness/hypotension on ixekizumab.
additional_comparator_evidence.limit: Small heterogeneous series with co-treatment; does not establish comparative efficacy for any single product.

additional_comparator_evidence.evidence: Symptom, lesion and DLQI improvement followed by retinoid discontinuation.
additional_comparator_evidence.limit: Single uncontrolled combination case, no direct barrier endpoint.

new_direct_adult_barrier_result.qualified_conclusion: No controlled adult-patient direct pharmacological barrier-restoration result was verified in this bounded pass. Not proof of absence.
unresolved: Clinical manuscript and participant-level dantrolene outcomes

noninferences: Do not equate clinical rating/QoL with direct barrier function.
Do not infer topical delivery from oral dosing.
Do not treat planned n20 as actual n.
Do not treat 10 completers as 10 responders.
Do not use nine-month retinoid-confounded improvement as dantrolene durability.
Do not treat one group clinical and cell papers as independent clinical replication.
A keratinocyte-only model may be unsuitable for an immune-biologic comparison.
